units.summary: Advance the frame-divider and skip one frame in eight. The update order is intentional: ingredient stepping precedes falling/collision, score and terminal-state handling.

units.summary: Update ingredient contact/queues, bonus, pepper, player control, enemy spawning/steering, collision, and transition animations. Demo input is supplied separately.

units.summary: Completion advances the active player's six-layout selector with wraparound. Death may switch players, rebuild the stage, or show game over; total stage and layout selector are separate counters.

units.name: HandleFinishedDeath
units.summary: Clear the terminal latch, then select demo termination, remaining-life restart or two-player handoff.

units.name: ShowGameOver
units.summary: Silence audio, clear display and show the game-over presentation. The one-player wait can be shortened by Start/Select; two-player paths draw the appropriate player banner.

units.name: PreparePlayerSwitch
units.summary: Clear the alternate nametable and sprites before restoring the next player's scene.

units.name: WaitBeforeBlanking
units.summary: Wait 95 NMI frames, then disable visible rendering.

units.name: ClearIngredientSpriteQueues
units.summary: Clear the two ingredient queues and mark their thirteen record slots FF (free).

units.name: WritePPUControl
units.summary: Store A in the software control shadow and PPUCTRL together.

units.name: WritePPUMask
units.summary: Store A in the software mask shadow and PPUMASK together.

units.name: DisableRendering
units.summary: Wait for vblank and clear the background/sprite enable bits in the mask shadow.

units.name: EnableRendering
units.summary: Wait for vblank and set background/sprite enable bits in the mask shadow.

units.name: DrawTitleAndWaitForStart
units.summary: Draw title/text, perform optional vertical reveal, then accept Start or toggle one/two-player selection with a release latch. A timer eventually returns to demo.

units.name: WaitTitleReveal
units.summary: Poll Start/Select while the NMI scroll service advances; terminate when the reveal reaches its end.

units.name: WaitStartRelease
units.summary: Wait for Start release before entering the title input loop.

units.name: PollTitleMenu
units.summary: Count elapsed frames as a two-byte value. Start begins a game; Select toggles player mode once per press; timeout schedules demo.

units.name: DrawScoresAndLabels
units.summary: Set active-player selector to zero and draw fixed labels plus the three six-digit scores. The caller is responsible for any later player selection.

units.summary: Spin on NMI handshake then clear it. Main code must allow NMI to progress; this is not a cycle-counted delay.

units.summary: Preserve A while polling PPUSTATUS until bit 7 is set.

units.summary: Clear nametables 2000 and 2800, then fall through to hide all OAM entries.

units.name: HideAllSprites
units.summary: Set Y of all 64 OAM entries to F0 and clear their remaining three bytes in the 0700 DMA shadow.

units.name: ClearNametable2000
units.summary: Select PPU address 2000 and use the common 1024-byte nametable clear.

units.name: ClearNametable2800
units.summary: Select PPU address 2800 and share rendering-disabled clear loop.

units.name: ClearSelectedNametable
units.summary: Blank one complete nametable including attributes, then restore scroll origin.

units.name: LoadPaletteHalf
units.summary: A selects background/sprite half; XY is source high/low. Wait for vblank, write sixteen bytes and reset PPU palette latch/scroll state.

units.name: ReadControllers
units.summary: Strobe both ports and rotate eight serial button bits into scratch. A selects player port; direction nibble and A/B are selected-port values, while Start/Select always come from port one.

units.name: WaitAndSetPPUAddress
units.summary: Wait for NMI, then write XY as high/low PPUADDR. The direct entry below omits the wait.

units.name: SetPPUAddress
units.summary: Write XY high/low into PPUADDR, retaining Y.

units.name: DrawEncodedText
units.summary: XY points to source-word/destination-word descriptor. Bytes FF end text, 0A starts a new row (+32 destination); other bytes become tiles by subtracting 20.

units.name: TextNewline
units.summary: Advance source past the newline and destination by one tile row, propagating carries, then resume text rendering.

units.name: ExpandPackedDecimalTiles
units.summary: Descriptor points to packed BCD RAM and specifies PPU destination/digit count. Walk digits most-significant first, map nibbles to tiles 10..19 and suppress leading zeros before submitting a row.

units.name: SuppressLeadingZero
units.summary: Convert a leading zero tile to blank until a nonzero digit appears. Preserve tile-output index X.

units.name: AddPackedDecimalScore
units.summary: A selects player and X is the packed decimal increment. Add it into three little-endian BCD bytes using explicit decimal correction; NES CPU decimal arithmetic is not assumed.

units.name: SetMainState
units.summary: Set the main-state selector to A; handlers later reenter the common dispatcher.

units.name: NMIEntry
units.summary: Preserve A/X/Y, DMA OAM from page 07, publish frame handshake, consume pending PPU row, update title scroll and service audio only during gameplay. Restore registers and RTI.

units.name: CorrectBCDAddition
units.summary: Correct low decimal digit then high decimal digit, returning carry on overflow beyond 99. This is software BCD adjustment for binary additions.

units.name: CorrectBCDDecrement
units.summary: After a binary decrement, change a low nibble F into 9 while retaining the high nibble. Caller owns any wider borrow behavior.

units.name: ResetScrollOrigin
units.summary: Set horizontal scroll to eight and vertical scroll to zero.
